note: PAGE_INVENTORY §3 (2026-09-06 Wave H). A–Z directory. Live counts on the rows, doors. Not a mini-Bend KPI Instrument. Caption carries the region count and months-of-supply verdict. tasteReview.beats: Versus Zillow Bend homes (https://www.zillow.com/bend-or/): desktop has sourced 4.4-month named-bar MOS and a non-Google Atlas. Versus Visit Bend: photography now leads the INDEX fold (photo + name + live count). Versus NYT Upshot: bars encode leftover inventory on the row. First-viewport named cities are tappable at 1440 and 375.
tells: Cream box. — combo-open: Overlay a city is a labeled hairline field whose cream popover is not the beUI combobox object (options restyled into a jammed grid, list inverted over the photographs, no visible check).

Cream box. — Directory / Tap a city: InfiniteMasonry is a clipped six-up photo strip (desktop) and a 2×2 tile grid (375), not the masonry demo (no load-more, no stacked columns, Bend's tall cell reads as a layout break).
tasteReview.dullest: The opened Overlay a city list: three cream rows parked on top of the new city photographs, with names jammed into the months (Bend3.4 mo), so the only compare on the page hides the only original move.
tasteReview.verdict: SITE-161 put photographed city doors (Bend, Redmond, Sisters, Sunriver, and two more) with live for-sale counts in the first viewport at 1440 and 375. That is the class job. The table-instrument judge (grok-4.6) scored median 54 with demoMatch false: combobox open is still a cream popover, masonry is a clipped strip not the load-more demo, alerts clip under Jax at 375, Atlas $ pills smear (SITE-159 exclusive — not retouched). Finish line 70 not reached. Node stays in_progress.

defects.finding: The first viewport is a cropped photo row, not beUI infinite-masonry: six uneven tiles, Bend's taller cell looks broken, no load-more or stacked columns, and the navy underlines are too thin to feel magnitude before the numeral.

defects.section: Overlay a city against the region (combo-open)
defects.finding: Opened control is a cream rectangle of three jammed rows covering the new photographs; city name runs into the months (Bend3.4 mo); search sits below the list; a person opening the beUI combobox demo would not recognize this as the same object.
Even in the resting desktop fold the ask is truncated to Hear about, and at 375 it reads Hear about new listings in Oregon the day they hit th — Jax and Cookies sit on the sentence.
Navy marks and $K labels collide into a smear over the Bend–Redmond–Sisters cluster, so the drawing does not read as distinct places. SITE-159 owns Atlas chips — not retouched here.

The 375 fold is directory plus combobox plus a clipped ask — no Atlas drawing and no months-of-supply bars — which breaks the place-page lock that a drawing and a figure sit beside the alerts sentence.
Balanced is said three times in one column (Seller ≤4 · balanced 4–6 · buyer ≥6, the SELLER'S/BALANCED/BUYER'S labels, and Balanced market at 4.4 months), which is padding, not one claim.

contentFloor.note: No-regression floor (ci:route-content-floor). A build under any number here fails before the evaluator runs. Lower a number only by hand, in the same commit, with the reason. heroImageNatural LOWERED 2043 -> 1382 (2026-09-23, PR #352 blocker; same root cause PR #351 found on oregon-city/place-type-community): the 2026-09-12 seed read heroImageWidth 120 / heroImageNatural 2271, which is exactly public/images/brand/logo-horizontal-navy-transparent.png (2271x454), the header wordmark, winning the widest-in-fold comparison on a page with no photographic hero. The /cities directory (SITE-161 fold: photo + name + live count in the first viewport) now puts a real city photo inside 1200px, rendered wider than the 120px logo, and that photo is delivered at 1536px natural (measured in PR #352 CI runs 35826352263 and 35860657259, identical both times). 1382 = floor(1536 * 0.9), the gate's own 0.9 tolerance on the real photo instead of the logo asset.
